message: 走れメロスのように？

name: Synn
message: 「I have to go... look for Nanaka」
I have to tell her.
That Nanaka isn't at fault, that she didn't do anything wrong.
That nobody blames her, and nobody thinks she betrayed us.
That I was the one who was a coward.

name: Ria
message: 「You know the Holy Night Festival is tomorrow, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're running for the sake of a friend! If you don't make it back by sunset, you'll be executed, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「That's... a little off」

name: Misa
message: 「You're the Student Council President, and you're just going to abandon everything and leave? Isn't that irresponsible?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh, finally turning into a full-fledged delinquent, huh! Go for it!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's... also a little off. But I'll do my best」
I bowed my head to each and every one of them.

name: Ria
message: 「Is it because she's your childhood friend?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure that's not the only reason」

name: Ria
message: 「Mm. Good, then. Besides, this only happened because you didn't keep Nanaka-chan locked down in the first place, y'know」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa. With a cage? Or packed in a box?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Confinement is rather unsettling, isn't it」
Ria-senpai gave a wry smile.

name: Synn
message: 「I'll get back as soon as I can」

name: Ria
message: 「No you won't」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't worry about hurrying back or anything like that. Just focus on finding Nanaka-chan」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I will contact Jeeves to have him help search for the Treasurer」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll get in touch with the Delicious Food Squad and Boss too」

name: Misa
message: 「As for the school festival preparations, we'll be fine even without you, Sakura-kun. In fact, things will go better without you」

name: Sally
message: 「Mhm. Because I'm here!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I believe it would be better if the Extra wasn't here either」

name: Sally
message: 「What was that?!」

name: Ria
message: 「You can't come back until you find Nanaka-chan, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much」
I bowed my head deeply.

name: Ria
message: 「Aah-ah. So once again, a woman of the Kujou family has no fate with the Demon Lord, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Ria
message: 「It's nothing」
Misa held out a cell phone to me with a sullen look on her face.

name: Misa
message: 「Take this with you. There's a chance we might be the ones to find Nanaka-san」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's only because you're so unreliable! If you look inside it, you won't get away with it!」
I try calling right away.
Out of service range or turned off so the call can't go through, huh.

name: Ria
message: 「It's passed down in the Kujou family that the Demon Lord will save the world, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'm not anything that grand」

name: Ria
message: 「You mustn't say things like that. You see, Nanaka-chan is definitely waiting for you to come find her, Synn-kun」
I wonder if that's true. I hope it is.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm heading off」

name: Ria
message: 「Have a safe trip」
